<tool_call>
<function=generate_music_selections>
<parameter=athlete_profile>
Pat is an endurance athlete who goes for long-distance runs on the weekend, usually about 10 miles. She needs music with a consistent rhythm to maintain a steady pace and keep her in a meditative state during the run.
</parameter>
<parameter=workout_type>
Long-distance running (10 miles)
</parameter>
<parameter=intensity>
Steady, moderate endurance
</parameter>
<parameter=mood_requirement>
Meditative, consistent rhythm
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
